paras: Phrynocephalus golubewii is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is endemic to Turkmenistan.
The specific name, golubewii, is in honor of Russian herpetologist Michael Leonidovich Golubev.
P. golubewii is found in southwestern Turkmenistan.
The preferred natural habitat of P. golubewii is desert salt flat, at altitudes below 100 m (330 ft).
